host.profile: ysk (initialized from the shipped web template: --from-default-profile web)

plugin.source: task worktree at branch feat/ysk-empty-state-dock (path not recorded on purpose)

browser.driver: playwright, loaded through PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE (no path baked into capture.cjs)
required_env: PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=<path to the playwright package entry> (or a resolvable 'playwright' install)
PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=<browsers root> when it is not the default <home>/Library/Caches/ms-playwright
browser.note: the installed chrome-headless-shell revision must match the playwright build; capture.cjs picks the newest chromium_headless_shell-* under the browsers root

data_control.empty: NO interception. The card rendered from the real authenticated host route GET api/dsh-you-should-know/notes; the observed response is recorded in empty-host-response.json (status 200, ok true, notes [], historyCount 0).
data_control.pending: GET api/dsh-you-should-know/notes fulfilled at the browser HTTP boundary AFTER the empty capture, with one active critical note.
data_control.history: GET api/dsh-you-should-know/notes + GET api/dsh-you-should-know/history fulfilled at the browser HTTP boundary AFTER the empty capture, with one active and one dismissed entry.
data_control.note: interception is installed only after 10-empty is written, so the empty proof is the real host route; pending/history are explicitly fixtures.

authentication: no cookie, token, or header is stored in the evidence; the page token lives only in the local capture command line and is not written to any file
